content: node-postgres docs (apis/pool): max default 10; idleTimeoutMillis default 10000 (0 disables); connectionTimeoutMillis default 0 = no timeout; min 0; maxLifetimeSeconds disabled by default. statement_timeout / idle_in_transaction_session_timeout / query_timeout are CLIENT-level options accepted by pool via pass-through ('All valid client config options are also valid here'). connectionTimeoutMillis 0 default is a hazard worth pinning in the D-8 budget spec.
